title: Test harness is a fail-fast hand-rolled Check(), not a framework
evidence: Tests/SoccerDataStoreTests.m:3 Check() calls exit(1) on first failed assertion, so only the first failure is ever reported and later assertions never run
suggestion: Accumulate failures or adopt XCTest so a single run reports every failing assertion
